### Named generic records

A prepared package exposes each closed alias-named generic record as a generated
struct. Use the installed header's field types and cleanup functions, and call
the concrete exported function without passing a Lean type argument. Different
aliases retain different names, including aliases of the same Lean application.

The [reviewed package checks](../evidence/reviewed-instantiations-20261008/receipt.json)
cover direct record exports and nine specializations over records, List and Option
aliases. They preserve compiler-resolved fields and alias origins through
source-free offline installation. Inherited, recursive, indexed and refined
generic records need separate evidence; these checks add no instance-dictionary
claim over records.
